verdict.rationale: Alacritty is a local desktop terminal emulator that runs entirely on the user's own machine. First-party docs show it can be built from source (`cargo build --release`, including feature flags such as Wayland-only builds) or installed via `cargo install`, package managers, or prebuilt binaries across BSD, Linux, macOS and Windows. Nothing in the evidence suggests any vendor-hosted dependency. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of current source builds (the only community build report is an old complaint about a pinned nightly Rust compiler).
